## What
Staging only, do not merge. Enrolls `model-executor` with `automatic_shard: true` so builds triggered with `VLLM_CI_BRANCH=agent/runtime-shard-planner` (vllm-project/ci-infra) run the step as runtime shards planned from main's timings, falling back to the normal single job if planning fails. Builds of other branches are unaffected.
